actual: After BUG-184 source and close-sync PRs were merged, cleanup-after-merge --apply failed because canonical root contained unrelated files from another task. The cleanup flow should not restore/delete/modify unrelated root dirty files, but it should distinguish task-owned generated differences from unrelated pollution and allow safe branch/worktree cleanup when source PR and close-sync PR are already merged. Required behavior: root sync remains blocked when fast-forward is unsafe; unrelated root dirty files are reported as ignored for cleanup, not treated as files to restore; task worktrees/branches can be cleaned if they are clean and merged.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
